entries.note: Round twenty-three: the paving and the hero flight to the frames' surfaces, measured. Still open: a 25 cm bare-soil strip along the tread ends where the surface mask forbids grass, the frame's dapple and shadow shapes on the plaza, the boulders (running).,

entries.note: Owner, in the game (2026-09-21 06:19 UTC): the trees stay green, they never render to brown even a foot away — every trunk must read brown the second you step in. Root causes found at player height (four trunk poses, 2-8 m): (1) trees/materials.ts BARK_DETAIL_MEAN held the ENCODED mean of tree_bark_03 (0.523) while texture2D on an sRGB map returns linear values (mean 0.254), so every lum/mean factor sat at its lower clamp — near bark darkened x0.55-0.68 within 6 m and x0.8 more at arm length, the distant boles near blend x0.46; (2) the bark shade floors were fully leaf-filtered light with a tenth of the bark own colour (a flat green column in shade, calibrated to the frames hazed trunks at 10-35 m); (3) moss covered half the low bole (threshold coarse > 0.51 below 4.5 m) with bright yellow-green tufts at 0.85 blend reading as leaves stuck on. Now: linear mean; floors keep 0.45-0.7 of their own bark with 0.2 leaf-filtered light, the near base lift 2.5 to 5; bark tint 0x9b7e62 to 0xa47c56; moss thresholds 0.5 to 0.62, sheets 0.18 to 0.3, tufts darker at half blend. Measured: the nwnear bole at 3 m sRGB mean 35/39/25 to 51/53/36, R/G 0.89 to 0.95; lantern giant at 8 m 37/39/28 to 46/46/35, R/G 0.94 to 1.01.
